+5.3 edge from raised guidance and revisions; it anchors the required Consumer Staples floor, and its credit-spread exit trigger (>50bp widening) has not hit.
+4.8 edge on underwriting strength and valuation, with no catastrophe-loss exit signal, so it is kept.
Thesis intact (flows still positive) and no newcomer reaches the 6.8 edge needed to replace it.
Kept to help meet the 12% Consumer Staples floor; its exit condition (Q3 guide cut below $0.80) has not occurred, and only the excluded PARR clears its 7.1 swap margin.
Flagged sale withdrawn: no exit condition has occurred and no eligible newcomer reaches the 5.6 edge needed to replace it, so both accounts keep it.
Thesis not broken (no margin-guide cut or refinancing issue) and no eligible newcomer clears its 4.7 replacement hurdle.
Kept per rules: the thesis is intact (no used-vehicle gross-profit-per-unit guide cut of $200 or more) and no newcomer clears its +4.0 swap hurdle.
Replaces IDCC within Technology (edge 4.0 clears IDCC's 3.3 hurdle), keeping the underweight Tech sleeve within its cap; high volatility is handled by edge/vol sizing.
+4.3 edge from accelerating revisions and power-generation contracts clears WMG's 2.7 hurdle; customer-concentration risk is acknowledged and its high volatility keeps it small.
+3.3 edge driven by VLGC freight rather than crude price, adding Energy exposure that is overweight in the macro view while diversifying the oil-price driver.
